results.title: Two people killed in car crash involving vehicle fleeing police in Leeds
results.snippet:
# Man and woman die in police pursuit crash

BBC Breaking News

Two people have been killed after their car was hit by a vehicle fleeing from police in Leeds.

West Yorkshire Police said it happened at 00.44 GMT, when a blue BMW 123D failed to stop for police in Gelderd Road. It then crashed into a white Volkswagen Scirocco.
